faqs.a: Most struggle. Tova runs both a standard text recogniser and Apple's Vision handwriting engine on the same photo, across several image treatments — higher contrast, sharpening, upscaling — and keeps whichever pass produced the most real characters. faqs.a: Temple placards and older brush writing are the hardest case and results vary. Tova includes a pass that binarises the image and reconnects broken strokes, which recovers a lot of faded inscriptions, but heavily stylised cursive can still defeat it.

faqs.q: Does handwriting scanning cost extra?
faqs.a: No. The handwriting passes run automatically on the free tier whenever the ordinary recogniser comes back empty or short.
